messages:
alex: Heads-up — the new sample app in the quickstart is failing on Vercel Edge with our latest SDK release. Anyone seen this?

dina: I hit it this morning. error from the runtime: 
```
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'default')
at init (/workspace/.vercel/build/index.js:45:23)
```

kevin: That smells like a CJS/ESM interop issue. Which export map did the sample use?

alex: The sample's package.json uses conditional exports to point to ./dist/node and ./dist/edge. snippet:
```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "node": "./dist/node/index.cjs",
    "default": "./dist/edge/index.mjs"
  }
}
```

nina: Right — Vercel Edge resolves the "default" branch and expects an ESM module, but our build still emits some CJS glue in the edge bundle (rollup plugin not set to preserve modules). The consume path ends up importing the CJS wrapper as ESM -> undefined.default.

kevin: Also saw TypeScript types not resolving for consumers: package.json lacks a types entry and our .d.ts files are in dist/types not referenced by exports, so editor onboarding is broken too.

dina: Repro steps I used: clone sample, npm i, deploy with vercel dev. Locally it runs with node --experimental-fetch fine but edge runtime fails.

alex: Short-term workaround I pushed to the sample: force the edge entry to a pure ESM build and update exports to explicit paths:
```
"exports": {
  "./node": "./dist/node/index.cjs",
  "./edge": "./dist/edge/index.mjs",
  ".": "./dist/node/index.cjs"
}
```
then import in sample with: `import sdk from 'our-sdk/edge'` to force the ESM path. Not great UX though.

kevin: For an SDK-level fix we should: 1) ensure edge build is pure ESM (no CJS wrapper), 2) add explicit exports subpaths for /node and /edge so bundlers don't guess, and 3) include "types" and a types-only export or use "exports" conditional types.

nina: Agree. Also worth adding a CI step that tries the package on a small Cloudflare Worker and Vercel Edge runtime to catch this earlier. Could be a lightweight smoke test.

alex: +1 on CI. Dina — can you open an issue with the sample repro and link the quickstart so we can track? I'll revert the sample change once we rollout proper fix.

dina: Filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/issues/142 — added logs and minimal repro. tagging @kevin for build fixes. :thumbsup:

kevin: I'll prototype a build patch today: split outputs, add explicit exports, and publish a beta tag. Expect a PR by EOD.

sam-bot: deploy-bot: New publish job queued for branch kevin/exportmap-edge-fix (build matrix: node14,node18,edge).

nina: One more gotcha — auth helpers: we export a default that wraps token logic in node build but edge build exported a named export only. That mismatch breaks sample import `import sdk from 'our-sdk'`. We should keep export parity.

kevin: Good catch. I'll make sure both builds expose the same surface (default + named). Also will add a small TS smoke that imports both `import sdk from` and `import { createClient } from` to ensure typings line up.

alex: Thanks y'all. If anyone finds more regressions in onboarding docs, drop them in the issue. This was the major blocker for new devs today.

dina: marking as blocked -> waiting on kevin/PR. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
